usedFor: ZenCommerce holds orders, products and customers, and Hastewire receives wording through “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in ZenCommerce, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A new product's description gets rewritten to sound natural.

watchOut: “Order Status Paid” in ZenCommerce needs a webhook URL and store connection set up before it runs.
